lines.beaver_en: Hello. May I ask about changes in traditional culture?
lines.en: Sure. Traditional culture has changed a lot.
In the past, masks were used only in folk performances.
These days there are mask dance festivals, so it has become popular.

lines.beaver: 탈을 직접 만들어 보는 사람도 많아요?
lines.beaver_en: Do many people make masks themselves?
lines.beaver_roman: Tareul jikjeop mandeureo boneun saramdo manayo?
lines.learner: 네, 여러 가지 탈을 다 만들어 보는 사람도 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, some people try making all kinds of masks.
lines.roman: Ne, yeoreo gaji tareul da mandeureo boneun saramdo isseoyo.

lines.learner: 외래 문화의 영향으로 서양식 건축물이 늘었어요.
lines.en: Due to foreign culture, Western-style buildings increased.
lines.roman: Oerae munhwaui yeonghyangeuro seoyangsik geonchungmuri neureosseoyo.

lines.learner: 한옥 양식으로 지은 교회나 성당도 있어요.
lines.en: There are even churches and cathedrals built in hanok style.
lines.roman: Hanok yangsigeuro jieun gyohoena seongdangdo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What is it like inside temples?
lines.en: The Buddha statues are the same, but monks use the internet too.

lines.beaver: 문화와 전통에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about culture and tradition?
lines.beaver_roman: Munhwawa jeontonge daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 널뛰기 같은 민속놀이는 이제 체험 행사가 됐어요.
lines.en: Folk games like neolttwigi are now hands-on events.
lines.roman: Neolttwigi gateun minsongnorineun ije cheheom haengsaga dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 옛것이 사라질까 봐 걱정되지는 않으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Then aren't you worried old things will disappear?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom yetgeosi sarajilkka bwa geokjeongdoejineun aneuseyo?
lines.learner: 조금 걱정되지만, 잘 배우고 지키면 돼요.
lines.en: I'm a little worried, but we just need to learn and protect it well.
lines.roman: Jogeum geokjeongdoejiman, jal baeugo jikimyeon dwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you so much for your kind words, sir.
lines.en: You're welcome. I hope your research goes well.
